text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) can cause common and serious side effects, ranging from mild symptoms to major health risks. You can review full prescribing and safety details on the Official Opsumit Website.

list.snippet: Stuffy or runny nose and sore throat (nasopharyngitis)
Anemia (low red blood cell count, which can cause pale skin or unusual tiredness)

Severe Birth Defects: Opsumit causes major birth defects if taken during pregnancy. It is strictly contraindicated during pregnancy, and individuals who can become pregnant must use effective birth control and complete regular pregnancy tests.
Liver Damage: It can cause elevated liver enzymes and liver injury. Warning signs include nausea, vomiting, fever, dark urine, upper right stomach pain, and yellowing of the skin or eyes (jaundice).
Fluid Retention and Edema: Swelling in the hands, legs, ankles, or feet—as well as rapid weight gain—can occur, particularly during the first few weeks of treatment.
Decreased Sperm Counts: Opsumit may reduce sperm production and affect male fertility.

text_blocks.snippet: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist immediately if you notice rapid weight gain, swelling, signs of liver problems, or any side effects that bother you or do not go away.
